title: Safeguard lifecycle orchestration and stakeholder notification
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create a concise, reproducible lifecycle orchestration for launch day that ties release blocker triage, automated and manual rollback triggers, and stakeholder notification flows into a single operational play. The artifact will be used by PM, Eng, SRE, Support, and Marketing during the runtime-1.22 launch window. This ticket covers: 1) preflight gating checklist for release readiness, 2) triage decision tree for release blockers with ownership and SLAs, 3) automated rollback conditions (metrics + health checks) and a manual rollback runbook, and 4) stakeholder contact matrix + templated notifications for incidents, rollbacks, and successful rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight checklist documented and signed off by Eng, SRE and Security
Triage decision tree published in Confluence and linked from the release page
Automated rollback policy encoded in deployment pipeline (canary abort + fallback model routing) with test simulation
Communication templates for Incident, Status Update, and Postmortem ready and reviewed by Comms
Stakeholder matrix with primary & secondary contacts and escalation paths added to the release checklist

communication_templates: Incident - Initial: Subject: [Incident] runtime-1.22 - {short summary}; Body: One-liner impact -> Affected customers -> Immediate mitigation -> Next update ETA -> Pager contacts. Link to runbook: <confluence link>

Incident - Status Update: Subject: [Update] runtime-1.22 - {summary}; Body: What changed since last update -> Current impact -> Actions in progress -> Expected next update time -> Public facing FAQ link (if available)

Rollback Notification: Subject: [Rollback] runtime-1.22 - {reason}; Body: Reason for rollback -> Time window -> Affected features/models -> Expected customer impact -> Rollback owner and contact -> Post-rollback validation plan
Launch Success: Subject: [Launch Complete] runtime-1.22; Body: Short summary of changes -> Key metrics to watch -> Links to release notes and console dashboards -> Thank you and next steps
